d:
Bihar men anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki hone vali shadi in dinon charcha ka vishay bani huee hai. unke svagat ke lie patna ke bihta men sasural paksh ne naya ghar banvaya hai. budhvar ko yahan grih pravesh ki puja huee. hone vali sas aasha devi ne kaha ki vah shivangi ko bahu nahin, beti banakar rakhengi.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
